baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb ظَنَّ and the definite noun ٱلْفِرَاقُ join an act of recognition to a specific separating event.
baseline_models.mechanism: An indication crosses an epistemic threshold and is identified as the event that sets joined sides apart.

activation_trace.role: Certainty reached from an indication makes the verb an epistemic threshold rather than a bare guess.
Setting two things apart supplies the definite event that the subject recognizes.

changed_reading.before: He merely suspects that something bad may happen.
changed_reading.after: He reads an indication and reaches the recognition: this is the separating event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظَنَّ can retain weak supposition while ٱلْفِرَاقُ still names an actual or anticipated separation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A weak sign yields an anxious forecast whose outcome is not yet trusted, so cognition and event remain slightly out of phase.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition keeps the subject's judgment short of full certainty.
An outcome that cannot be relied upon makes the object of thought ominously unresolved.
Actual separation gives the uncertain forecast a concrete endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The verb must report settled knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The focus alone also permits an anxious construal: he expects parting while its exact outcome remains untrusted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognitive verb ظَنَّ immediately governs a noun whose root includes the heart's splitting under fear.
baseline_models.mechanism: The anticipated external separation rebounds inward: supposition about parting simultaneously scatters the subject's composure.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain apprehension supplies the mental pressure that can fracture composure.
Fear as an inwardly split heart turns parting into an affective event as well as an external one.

changed_reading.before: Parting is only an external severance.
changed_reading.after: The sentence can also stage the subject coming apart inwardly as he apprehends the external parting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The expected-place branch of ظ ن ن and the road-fork branch of ف ر ق meet in the definite phrase ٱلْفِرَاقُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A recognizable sign marks a branching point: the subject identifies the present threshold as the place where one course divides from another.

activation_trace.role: An expected sign or location lets the verb function as recognition of a marked threshold.
A road's branching point supplies the spatial mechanism for the recognized parting.

changed_reading.before: The noun denotes only the loss of a prior bond.
changed_reading.after: It can also mark a threshold where the route itself divides and a new course begins.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible dread, anticipation of a back-breaking event, bodily arrival at a limit, and a last healing appeal accumulate as indications; the focus verb now reads as a diagnosis forced by embodied evidence.

activation_trace.role: A face contracted by intense aversion supplies an outward, visible indication of dread.
The preceding use of indication-based certainty rehearses the focus ayah's epistemic movement.
A back-breaking calamity supplies the feared event anticipated immediately before the focus.
Arrival at an endpoint makes the sign-chain bodily and apparently irreversible.
Protective healing recitation supplies the final attempted interruption before recognition of parting.
The focus verb converts the accumulated signs into recognition.
The focus noun names the separation diagnosed from those signs.

structural_cues: 75:24-28 forms an uninterrupted escalation from facial state to anticipated calamity, bodily limit, rescue query, and recognition.
The definite ٱلْفِرَاقُ presents the conclusion as an identified event, while the branchless ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ in 75:26 remains structural rather than branch-cited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered signs and their branch images; I infer that their accumulation causes the shift from anticipation in 75:25 to diagnosis in 75:28. A live alternative is that both uses of ظن remain uncertain despite the escalation.

changed_reading.before: The focus could be an isolated supposition about generic parting.
changed_reading.after: It culminates a sign-chain: visible dread and a bodily endpoint force the recognition, 'this is the parting.'

context_deltas.mechanism: The self contains insight that survives the casting of excuses; the focus recognition therefore becomes involuntary self-witness rather than information received from outside.

activation_trace.role: Intellect and inward awareness locate the relevant evidence within the self.
Insight of the heart gives the self direct access to what it otherwise might deny.
Casting something outward supplies the attempted displacement of inward knowledge.
Excuse and exculpation supply the defensive material that fails to cancel self-witness.
Indication-based certainty renders the focus cognition an inward concession.
Separation is the fact to which the inward witness finally yields.

structural_cues: 75:14-15 opposes self-insight to outwardly offered excuses before 75:28 returns to private cognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward sight and unsuccessfully cast excuses; I infer that this self-witness remains active when the subject recognizes parting. The alternative is that 75:14-15 concerns moral accounting only and does not govern the dying subject's cognition.

changed_reading.before: He infers parting from an unspecified external sign.
changed_reading.after: He is compelled to admit inwardly what the self already sees, even after the surah has staged defensive excuses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated acts of gathering bodies, heavenly bodies, and recitation establish collection as a surah-wide operation, while disclosure itself can work by separation; the focus parting becomes an ordered counter-operation rather than mere collapse.

activation_trace.role: Joining what was dispersed supplies the physical counter-operation to the focus separation.
A second gathering extends the same operation to a cosmic pair.
Gathering recitation extends collection from matter to discourse.
Disclosure through separation shows that distinction can reveal order rather than destroy it.
The focus noun becomes the separating pole in the packet's gather-and-distinguish pattern.

structural_cues: The same gathering root recurs in 75:3, 75:9, and 75:17 across bodily, cosmic, and recitational domains.
75:17-19 orders gathering, recitation, following, and clarification as controlled operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated gathering and a disclosure branch grounded in separation; I infer an operational counterpoint with the focus root. The alternative is that these repetitions are thematic parallels and do not alter the semantics of ٱلْفِرَاقُ.

changed_reading.before: Parting is unstructured disintegration or loss.
changed_reading.after: Parting can be an ordered distinguishing operation within a surah that repeatedly gathers dispersed things.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two plural sets of faces display opposed states before the focus narrows to one subject; separation therefore acquires a classificatory function whose result becomes visible in persons.

activation_trace.role: The face standing for the person lets visible state classify whole selves.
Radiant freshness marks one visibly disclosed class.
The repeated person-as-face construction establishes a parallel second class.
The contracted, averse face supplies the contrasting visible state.
Distinct kinds and aspects give the focus separation a classificatory edge.

structural_cues: 75:22 and 75:24 use parallel plural-face clauses with opposed predicates, followed by the singular cognition of 75:25-28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two visibly opposed face groups; I infer that their distinction activates a sorting sense in the focus separation. The alternative is simple juxtaposition of outcomes with no classificatory force in 75:28.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only one individual's severance.
changed_reading.after: That individual recognition can also be the subjective side of a wider separation into visibly disclosed states.

context_deltas.mechanism: Escape and refuge are negated, the destination and settlement are named, and post-focus wrapping leads into being driven; parting is thus a compelled, destination-bearing passage rather than undirected disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Flight supplies the route the subject seeks but cannot obtain.
Refuge supplies the protective endpoint explicitly denied.
Lordship supplies the governing destination toward which the passage is oriented.
Fixity and settlement give the movement a terminal station rather than open-ended dispersal.
One thing wrapping onto another supplies a paradoxical binding immediately after separation is recognized.
Driving and herding supply the directional force that carries the subject onward.
The focus separation becomes the boundary crossed in this compelled route.

structural_cues: 75:12 and 75:30 repeat إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ, first with settlement and then with driving, around the focus event.
75:10-11 closes escape and refuge, while 75:29-30 immediately supplies binding and onward motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied escape, named destination, settlement, wrapping, and driving; I infer that these arrows turn parting into transfer. The alternative is that they describe consequences after a separation whose own meaning remains simple severance.

changed_reading.before: Parting is an undirected loss into absence.
changed_reading.after: Parting is a forced boundary-crossing with no refuge, oriented toward a governed destination and settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human's earlier and later convenient calculations are framed by preference for the immediate and abandonment of the later; the focus ظن reverses that motivated presumption into recognition of the boundary it tried to defer.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the earlier cognitive stance that discounts gathering.
The repeated supposition closes the frame with the expectation of being left without constraint.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the preference bias behind the convenient calculation.
Deliberate leaving supplies the neglected later horizon that parting makes unavoidable.
Being left as one is supplies the false expectation of unaccountable continuity.
Indication-based certainty reverses the packet's earlier self-serving suppositions.
The focus separation is the deferred boundary that can no longer be cognitively left aside.

structural_cues: 75:3 and 75:36 repeat the frame أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ around the central focus sequence.
75:20-21 explicitly contrasts attachment to the immediate with leaving the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated supposition and an immediate-versus-later preference; I infer that preference motivates the earlier cognition and that the focus recognition breaks it. The alternative is that the rhetorical حسب questions and the singular subject of 75:28 should not be psychologized as one continuous agent.

changed_reading.before: ظَنَّ is a generic report of cognition at death.
changed_reading.after: It is the reversal point where convenient presumption of continuity collapses into recognition of the boundary long left out of view.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured generative origin, effective capacity, loss of life, and renewed life place death within a transformable sequence; the focus separation is terminal for a relation or phase but not equivalent to ontological extinction.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity supplies the agency capable of carrying the sequence beyond death.
Generative fluid from which form is measured supplies the sequence's small material origin.
Possession of life and spirit supplies the positive state that can be restored.
Loss of force and life defines death as deprivation rather than nonbeing.
Separation names the boundary within the life-death-life sequence, not the erasure of every term.

structural_cues: 75:37-40 moves from generative material through formed differentiation to the explicit capacity to give life to the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origin, death, life, and effective capacity; I infer that their sequence blocks an annihilation reading of the focus separation. The alternative is that the closing sequence proves only a sequel after death and does not modify the lexical force of ٱلْفِرَاقُ.

changed_reading.before: The recognized parting is absolute disappearance.
changed_reading.after: It is a real ending of a joined state, but one situated inside a sequence in which life can follow death.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the derived recovery branch of ف ر ق rather than treating it as the noun's direct gloss. It remains anchored in the focus root and the immediately preceding healing branch; downstream prose should present it only as an ironic lexical inversion, not as a translation claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun ٱلْفِرَاقُ shares its root with recovery imagined as illness departing the patient.

activation_trace.role: Protective healing recitation supplies the separation from illness that the question seeks.
Recovery as illness departing supplies the expectation that the focus event bitterly reverses.
Ordinary separation keeps the inversion anchored in the actual focus noun.

changed_reading.before: A request for healing is simply followed by recognition of death.
changed_reading.after: The sequence admits a bitter inversion: separation of illness from the patient is sought, but the separation recognized is the patient's own parting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the specialized laboring-animal branch of the focus root with post-focus embryological material and reads the sequence backward. It remains anchored in ٱلْفِرَاقُ and packet-supplied generative stages; downstream prose should qualify it as a reverse-birth analogy, never as the noun's lexical definition or a settled doctrine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ف ر ق includes a laboring creature that leaves its group, allowing parting itself to carry a birth-adjacent image.

activation_trace.role: A laboring creature separating from its group supplies the birth-adjacent motion anchored in the focus root.
A small quantity of generative fluid supplies the material beginning of embodied life.
Material from which form is measured supplies a second generative stage.
Pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies attachment before the eventual separation.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies the relational state inverse to parting.

changed_reading.before: Death-parting only reverses life by ending it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it mirrors birth: attachment and pairing give way to a separating passage into another phase.

strongest_changes: The embodied sign-chain converts ظَنَّ from free-standing supposition into recognition forced by visible and bodily evidence.
Denied refuge, repeated orientation to the Lord, settlement, and driving make ٱلْفِرَاقُ a directed passage rather than undirected disappearance.
Repeated gathering and the closing life-death-life capacity prevent separation from collapsing into annihilation.
The repeated حسب frame makes the focus cognition a reversal of motivated presumption rather than a generic thought at death.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed operational reversals around the compact focus: gathering and separating, inward witness and cast excuses, loving the immediate and leaving the later, denied flight and compelled driving, attachment and parting, death and renewed life. These preserve several coexisting readings without forcing one referent for what is separated.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus form alone does not settle whether ظَنَّ is full recognition or anxious supposition; context strongly favors but does not mechanically prove the former.
The opposed face groups may activate classificatory separation, or they may only juxtapose outcomes near an individual death scene.
The packet does not explicitly name the two terms separated by ٱلْفِرَاقُ, so body-life, person-world, relation-phase, and route-boundary models should remain distinct.
The healing inversion and reverse-birth model depend on form-distant branch activation and require explicit exploratory containment.
